Chapter 343 - 343 Send; Become A Mine Owner!

Chapter 343 - 343 Send; Become a Mine Owner!

343 Send; Become a Mine Owner!

Lin Fan’s mind was filled with the biology knowledge that he had just obtained.

Therefore, he did not stay in school for long. Instead, he drove the Mercedes-Benz G-Class alone and went straight back to Coiling Dragon Villa.

On the coffee table in the living room, there was a stack of documents… ‘Human Islet Recovery Medicine Technique.”

Next to it were bottles of transparent liquid.

Obviously, this was the reward for completing the mission.

These bottles of transparent liquid were precisely the human islet recovery medicine.

Lin Fan thought about it and called out, “Lil White.”

“Master, please give your instructions.” The super smartwatch on his wrist made a crisp sound and flashed a gentle light.

Lin Fan’s lips twitched. Where did this guy learn his lines from?

“Can you help me register the patent of the human islet recovery medicine?” As Lin Fan spoke, he waved the bottles and documents in his hands.

Even though Lin Fan did not lack money, directly contributing his technology was… He was not able to do so.

He was not a good person.

The super smartwatch shot out a red beam of light and scanned the documents and the human inlet recovery medicine.

“Of course, no problem.”

Then, countless codes appeared on the super smart watch.

About ten minutes later, Lil White spoke again, “Master, I’ve already registered a global patent.”

At the same time, electronic patent documents appeared on the screen of the super smart watch.

Lin Fan said, “Not bad.”

“Thank you for your compliment, Master,” said Lil White happily.

A smiley emoji appeared on its screen.

Lin Fan looked at the computer not far away and muttered, “Let’s just write the thesis.”

As he spoke, he strode forward.

Five seconds later, the computer turned on.

A series of extremely complicated papers appeared on the screen.

About an hour later, a complete thesis appeared!

Lin Fan wrote his name in the first author position.

Wu Tian and Zheng Qian were written as the second authors.

When he was working on the super battery thesis, Zhao Xueqin and Li Rongfa were the ones who showed Lin Fan the experiment.

Hence, Lin Fan put down their names as the second authors.

This time, Wu Tian and Zheng Qian let him watch the biological experiment. Naturally, Lin Fan would not be biased.

“I sent it to Science last time, so I’ll send it to Nature this time.”

Lin Fan muttered to himself. He found Nature’s email and sent it.

Then, Lin Fan said, “Lil White, do the same as last time. Get the thesis approved in the shortest time possible.”

“Leave it to me, Master!” Lil White said.

…

At this time, it was early in the morning in America.

Barry Aiken, the editor of Nature, was lying on a soft bed, sleeping soundly.

The next moment, the sound system, television, washing machine, and refrigerator in his house… All the electrical appliances that could make a sound rang out at the loudest volume.

Barry Aiken was so frightened that he stood up. His eyes widened as he cried out in surprise, “The machines have turned into monsters!”

Plop!

Then, he fell straight to the ground and fainted.

It was also at this moment that the electrical appliances in the room returned to normal.

This happened to Esmond Bevans, who was also an editor of Nature, as well… All the electrical appliances are ringing.

…

That night, the appliances in the homes of many Nature editors turned on automatically and made sounds.

Some editors fainted from fright, while others fell ill from fright… As for the chief editor, he found an email in his computer mailbox—Principles of Human Islet Recovery Medicine.

The next day, in the Humph University’s biomedicine laboratory, under the leadership of several world-famous biomedicine professors, an extremely urgent experiment was carried out.

…

Lin Fan was completely oblivious to all of this.

He had just woken up from his dream and looked at his phone screen.

[Notice from Merchant Bank: 7,532,102 yuan was deposited into your account.]

Lin Fan put his phone aside and muttered, “Let’s see what I can get by signing in today.”

“Sign in!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained the mountains in the southern suburbs of Jiangbei City.]

“Mountains in the southern suburbs? What’s the use of this? I can’t be the king of the mountains…” Lin Fan shook his head and said, “Forget it. It’s better than ten million.”

At this moment, Lin Fan’s phone rang.

He looked at the caller ID and saw that it was Liu Yuhang.

Lin Fan had a good impression of Liu Yuhang.

Firstly, if Liu Yuhang had not provided him with the information about the 100-year-old ginseng, Lin Fan would have had to spend a lot more time to obtain the 100-year-old ginseng and obtain the right to purchase Medical Water.

Secondly, Liu Yuhang’s personality and character were both very good.

Therefore, Lin Fan pressed the answer button.

“Good morning, Brother Lin Fan! Did I disturb your rest?” As soon as the call connected, Liu Yuhang’s loud voice came through.

Lin Fan said, “No, I’ve been up for a while.”

“That’s good!” Liu Yuhang said. “Brother Lin Fan, I have good news for you!”

“Good news?” Lin Fan asked curiously.

Liu Yuhang did not answer immediately. Instead, he asked, “Brother Lin Fan, the mountains in the southern suburbs of Jiangbei are under your name, right?”

Liu Yuhang already knew about the mountains when he had just acquired them?

Was he that resourceful?

Even though he was thinking this way, Lin Fan still replied, “Yeah, why?”

“It really is you, Brother Lin Fan! Hahaha! Brother Lin Fan, congratulations, you’ve found a mine in that mountain, a gold mine!” Liu Yuhang shouted excitedly.

He seemed happier than if he were to discover his own mine.

Lin Fan was stunned.

He never expected to find a gold mine in the mountains!

In that case, would he not become a legendary mine owner?

“Brother Lin Fan, according to the expert’s estimation, the gold ore in your mountains is worth more than tens of billions of yuan!”

Initially, Lin Fan was a little curious and happy that he had become a mine owner.

After hearing Liu Yuhang’s words, he became much calmer.

Worth tens of billions of yuan?

He owned several companies and buildings of the same value.

His shares in Little Tanuki Group and Penguin Group had reached more than a trillion!

He really did not need to care too much about a mere tens of billions of yuan.

Hence, Lin Fan said, “Is that so? Then my luck isn’t bad.”

He had obtained a gold mine worth tens of billions of yuan.

However, he only said one sentence. His luck was not bad?

Was this just ‘not bad’?

This was great, alright?!

If it were someone else, they would probably jump up in joy!

However, Liu Yuhang thought about how Lin Fan had increased his funds by 400% in three days. He felt a little enlightened.

After all, for a financial genius, tens of billions were nothing, right? Yes, that should be it.
